name: SHA / Provenance Manifest Cache
context: Phase 15E showed SHA hashing costs ~811ms/run (36% of setup), manifest cache eliminates this

manifest_design.format: JSON with per-layer records (layer, filename, size, sha256, fallback)
manifest_design.validation: file existence + size match, fallback to full hash if stale

recommended_next: Phase 15G: I/O optimization via mmap, or freeze/tag checkpoint
